evaluated_conduct: The appellate procedural disposition in D&A Pharma v EMA concerning interest in bringing proceedings and the limits of appellate review.

reasoning.statement: The EU appellate procedural framework applies to the Court of Justice appeal and the Court dismissed the appeal in full.
A procedural dismissal does not itself determine the scientific merits of the medicinal product or transform the underlying CHMP opinion into a broader substantive legal result.

unresolved_questions: Any separate proposition about the underlying CHMP scientific assessment or EMA administrative merits requires its own source-bounded analysis.

mizan.explanation: No Mizan result is generated from an appellate procedural dismissal.

review.notes: Staged from issue #164 as a narrow procedural observation. Canonical promotion requires explicit review after corpus validation and immediate pre-promotion dedup.
